meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总指定时间内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要整理多场会议纪要并形成周报
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes from a date range into structured reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into weekly reports

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把指定时间范围内的会议纪要汇总成结构化报告：单日输出“今日会议概览”，多日输出“会议纪要周报”，包含会议时间、主题、纪要及逐字稿链接，无纪要的会议会标注。
howto.when: 当你说要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报，或回顾某段时间开了哪些会时触发。默认汇总过去 7 天，可按“今天”“这周”等推断时间范围。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要
say.note: 生成本周会议纪要周报
汇总上周会议并输出周报

howto.what_en: After installed, Claude aggregates meeting notes within a specified time range into a structured report: single-day output as 'Today's Meeting Overview', multi-day as 'Meeting Weekly Report', including meeting time, topic, note and transcript links, marking meetings without notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to organize meeting notes, generate a meeting weekly report, or review meetings in a time range. Defaults to the past 7 days; infers ranges like 'today' or 'this week'.

say_en.text: Help me organize this week's meeting notes
